Example order sets

Source: R/example-data.R
dp_example_orders.Rd

Complete, legal order sets that go with dp_example_game().

Usage

dp_example_orders(
  phase = c("spring_1901", "fall_1901", "retreat", "build"),
  map = dp_map()
)

Arguments

phase

Which set to build:

  • "spring_1901" – a plausible opening for all seven powers.

  • "fall_1901" – a follow-up set for the same position.

  • "retreat" – the retreat that goes with dp_example_game("retreat").

  • "build" – the adjustments that go with dp_example_game("build").

map

A dp_map object.

Value

A dp_orders tibble.

See also

Other orders: as_tibble.dp_orders(), dp_bind_orders(), dp_legal_orders(), dp_order(), dp_orders, dp_parse_orders(), format.dp_orders(), is_dp_orders()

Examples

dp_example_orders("spring_1901")
#> <dp_orders> (22 orders)
